bookingOpens: Online through the booking window on the restaurant's website (Guestplan), or by phone or email (info@restaurant-212.com). Lunch Wednesday to Saturday, 12pm to 1.30pm; dinner Tuesday to Saturday, 6.30pm to 9pm.
groups: Tables of more than 4 are served only the chef's menu. The private dining room in the wine cellar seats up to 10, with a 5-course chef's menu; book it online up to 7 days ahead, or email events@group-212.com for later requests.
